parameters.content:
## ⚙ CONFIGURATION
- **CONTROL_ROOM_BASE_URL**: enter it in the **Config Base URL** node (Value field). No trailing slash.
  It is reused for drafts, policy-check, agent-runs, and publish-receipt.
- **projectId**: default `proj_aeon` (migration seed). Required on policy-check + drafts so Control Room can inject the composed context pack.
- **Exa API**: after import, attach Header Auth credential **Exa API** (`x-api-key` = Exa key) to **MKT-02 ▪ Exa search**. Do not commit the key. Researcher must not POST `/drafts`.
- Re-import this file **over** existing workflow `Mr2NsTTTVKvuGZKa`. Do not duplicate. Do not touch Studio Generate `58oYBY2ODlpRYhcc`.
- **Staging is the default.** No real social publishing happens until you attach production credentials on the per-channel publisher nodes.

## 🔐 N8N_INGRESS_SECRET + HMAC
Configure the **N8N_INGRESS_SECRET** value inside the **Crypto credential** attached to the two "HMAC Sign" nodes (draft + receipt).
The secret lives only in the credential — never in parameters, output, logs or the HTTP body.

**Signature spec (identical for draft & receipt):**
message = timestamp + "." + rawBody
signature = lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(N8N_INGRESS_SECRET, message)
rawBody is serialized ONCE and the exact bytes are signed and transmitted — never re-serialized.
Headers sent: Content-Type: application/json, X-N8N-Timestamp, X-N8N-Signature.

## ⏸ MKT-04 APPROVAL LIFECYCLE
- Wait resumes **On Webhook Call** (POST). The Control Room calls {{ $execution.resumeUrl }} (sent in the draft body) to resume this exact execution.
- Protected by **Header Auth** using a SEPARATE credential **N8N_RESUME_SECRET** (never reuse N8N_INGRESS_SECRET).
  Open this Wait node and set Authentication = Header Auth, selecting the N8N_RESUME_SECRET credential.
- Finite **24h** max wait for staging.

**APPROVAL IS NOT PUBLICATION.** The Control Room only marks content PUBLISHED after it receives a successful publish receipt from MKT-05.
Missing/malformed decisions **fail closed**. REJECTED and REVISION_REQUESTED can never reach a publisher.

## 🚫 NO AI AFTER APPROVAL
After APPROVED, there is **absolutely no LLM / generative rewrite**. The exact human-approved revision (title/body) is what publishes.
Only deterministic platform formatting is permitted downstream.

## 🔌 REAL SOCIAL CREDENTIALS
Attach production publish nodes/credentials on the per-channel publisher nodes (TWITTER / LINKEDIN / DISCORD / EMAIL / BLOG).
Until then, every channel converges on the **Staging Mock Publisher** which mints a clearly-marked TEST post id/URL and never posts publicly.
A publisher failure routes to **Build FAILED Receipt** so a FAILED receipt is still signed and sent.

## MKT-02 Researcher (v2)
After **Assert Policy Allowed**: Build research task (contextPack) → **one Exa search** → Researcher LLM (system = pack) → Parse JSON (**throws** on non-JSON).
- Sources **must** come from Exa hits. No hypothetical citations.
- `researchBrief` stays a **string** for existing Creator.
- Attach **Exa API** Header Auth (`x-api-key`). Re-attach OpenAI if needed.
- Do **not** add Notion / Sheets / Gmail. Do **not** POST `/drafts` from this stage.
- Re-import over `Mr2NsTTTVKvuGZKa` only.
